MOLECULAR GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

PATIENT INFORMATION
Name: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Sex: Female
Referring Clinician: Dr. [redacted name]
Date of Report: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Preimplantation genetic diagnosis (PGD) eligibility assessment for Huntington disease (HD). Patient has 50% risk of inheriting HD but declines predictive testing. Family history significant for HD in maternal lineage.

FAMILY HISTORY
Patient's mother affected with HD (onset age 45). Maternal grandfather also affected. Patient asymptomatic at age 32. Partner has no family history of HD.

TEST PERFORMED
Linkage analysis for Huntington disease using polymorphic microsatellite markers flanking the HTT gene
Methodology: PCR amplification of 17 polymorphic markers spanning the HTT locus on chromosome 4p16.3
Samples analyzed: Patient, partner, patient's mother (affected), patient's father (unaffected)

MARKERS ANALYZED
D4S2936, D4S3038, HD.STR2, D4S43, D4S1614, D4S127, 4-3021432, D4S126, I1CAHD, D4S3034, 4-3347773, D4S412, 4-3798971, D4S3023, D4S2925, D4S2285, D4S2366

RESULTS

HAPLOTYPE ANALYSIS

Marker		Position (Mb)	Mother		Father		Patient		Partner
D4S2936		2.85		142/146		138/144		142/144		140/148
D4S3038		2.91		224/228		220/226		224/226		222/230
HD.STR2		3.02		108/112		104/110		108/110		106/114
D4S43		3.08		172/176		168/174		172/174		170/178
D4S1614		3.12		285/289		281/287		285/287		283/291
D4S127		3.18		156/160		152/158		156/158		154/162
4-3021432	3.24		198/202		194/200		198/200		196/204
D4S126		3.31		244/248		240/246		244/246		242/250
I1CAHD		3.37		132/136		128/134		132/134		130/138
D4S3034		3.43		216/220		212/218		216/218		214/222
4-3347773	3.49		188/192		184/190		188/190		186/194
D4S412		3.55		264/268		260/266		264/266		262/270
4-3798971	3.61		176/180		172/178		176/178		174/182
D4S3023		3.67		228/232		224/230		228/230		226/234
D4S2925		3.73		152/156		148/154		152/154		150/158
D4S2285		3.79		204/208		200/206		204/206		202/210
D4S2366		3.85		168/172		164/170		168/170		166/174

PHASE DETERMINATION
Based on the inheritance pattern and affected status of the mother, the maternal chromosome carrying alleles 142-224-108-172-285-156-198-244-132-216-188-264-176-228-152-204-168 represents the HIGH-RISK haplotype.

The patient has inherited this high-risk haplotype from her affected mother. The low-risk haplotype inherited from the unaffected father consists of alleles 144-226-110-174-287-158-200-246-134-218-190-266-178-230-154-206-170.

Partner's phase could not be determined due to absence of parental samples.

INFORMATIVITY ASSESSMENT
The couple is informative for 17/17 (100%) markers tested. All markers show different allele combinations between the patient's high-risk and low-risk haplotypes, allowing clear discrimination.

INTERPRETATION
This linkage analysis demonstrates that preimplantation genetic diagnosis for Huntington disease by exclusion testing is feasible for this couple. The analysis has successfully identified the high-risk chromosome inherited from the affected mother and the low-risk chromosome from the unaffected father.

Using the flanking markers analyzed, embryos can be tested to determine whether they have inherited the high-risk or low-risk chromosome from the patient. The predicted misdiagnosis rate is <1% when using multiple informative flanking markers as demonstrated in this analysis.

LIMITATIONS
1. This test does not determine the patient's HD status
2. Recombination between markers and the HTT gene, though rare, could lead to misdiagnosis
3. Allele dropout during single cell analysis may affect PGD accuracy
4. Partner's phase not established; parental samples would improve analysis

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Proceed with IVF/PGD using the established haplotype information
2. Embryo biopsy and testing should include multiple markers to minimize error
3. Consider confirmatory prenatal testing (CVS or amniocentesis) if pregnancy is achieved
4. Genetic counseling should continue throughout the PGD process
5. Consider obtaining parental samples from partner if available to establish phase

Authorized by: Dr. [redacted name], Clinical Molecular Geneticist
Date: [redacted date]
